public_rationale: SignalFire's analysis of 2024 hiring, available May 20, 2025, documents weaker graduate hiring and discusses funding conditions and AI as possible explanations [e4]. It does not document substitution of demonstrably inadequate AI for entry-level work or actual cuts to training or mentorship attributable to anticipated AI displacement [e4]. It therefore neither contradicts the narrow claim nor establishes that credible documentation of those practices was absent by June 16, 2025 [e4].
limitations: Hiring declines alone do not establish premature AI substitution or reductions in entry-level development caused by expectations of AI displacement [e4].
This evidence item cannot establish that no other credible documentation was publicly available by June 16, 2025 [e4].
